messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — I need cross-team sign-offs on the Launch Gates checklist for Optimize-v1. Customer asks: predictable latency, graceful fallback, and rollout controls. Posting checklist + decision points. please respond by EOD. :eyes:

Chad (Eng): thanks. can you attach acceptance criteria? i sketched a draft below, pinging @Sam for metrics and @Alex for security gating.

Maya (PM): added draft ACs inline. short and testable.

Priya (Design): UX acceptance: error UI must show subtle fallback state (no modal), preserve user text, include a toast + telemetry event. sample copy: "Using a lower-latency model — results may vary."

Chad (Eng): Technical ACs (draft):
- p50 end-to-end latency <= 180ms on standard payloads
- p95 <= 500ms under steady load
- request error rate < 0.5% (5xx + timeouts)
- automatic fallback to small-ctx quantized model with identical API surface on model error
- KV/prefix cache preserved across fallback
- rollout to 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on failure conditions

Sam (Observability): Metrics we need in the gate:
- latency buckets (p50/p90/p95) per model variant
- 5xx + timeout rate per minute
- quality regression metric: eval-set pass rate delta (compare against canary baseline)
- token cost delta (tokens per request)
- user-visible error events count

Chad (Eng): edge cases to call out:
- partial token generation then error (should return fallback with a deterministic separator)
- streaming clients expecting content-length header -> stream behavior must be identical across variants
- concurrent KV cache invalidation during fallback

Alex (Security): gating notes:
- KMS key access must be present for private deployments before canary begins
- audit logs required for each rollout step (who triggered, commit hash, config)
- privacy check: no PII preserved in debug logs; sampling allowed

Maya (PM): here's the checklist I'm proposing (please react with :white_check_mark: when you sign off):
```
[Launch Gate Checklist - Optimize-v1]
1) Acceptance criteria green (eng + design)
2) Observability: dashboards + alerts wired (Sam)
3) Security: KMS + audit logs (Alex)
4) Rollout plan in infra (1/5/25/100) + automatic rollback rules (Chad)
5) Backstop policy: default to hosted fallback pool if private capacity low
6) Release notes & customer comms drafted
7) Post-launch quality evals scheduled (1h, 6h, 24h)
```

Sam (Observability): i can own 2 + the eval dashboards. suggested alert: sustained 3x baseline error rate for 5 minutes -> rollback.

Chad (Eng): rollout automation details:
- use canary-controller v2 (infra config attached in ticket)
- rollback triggers: error rate > 3x baseline OR quality delta > 1.5% on eval set OR p95 > 1s for >5m
- manual kill switch: /release abort <release-id>

Priya (Design): sign-off on UX ACs. will add copy variations in the PR.

Alex (Security): sign-off on gating after small follow-ups: who rotates KMS in private? need runbook. once that's added, :white_check_mark:.

Maya (PM): noted. adding runbook task to the ticket. decision log entry below.

Maya (PM): Decision log:
- Decided: rollout cadence = 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on conditions above. Rationale: balance exposure and signal.
- Decided: fallback path = quantized small-ctx model with same API + preserved cache. Rationale: lowest disruption for clients.
- Open: final wording for customer comms (Priya to propose)

deploy-bot: build status for canary-controller v2 -> success (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

Chad (Eng): I'm fine to own the rollout automation and rollback implementation. will create the infra PR and link it here.

Sam (Observability): created dashboard draft: /dashboards/optimize-v1-canary. linking in ticket.

Maya (PM): ok — next steps:
- Chad: infra PR + rollback runbook (owner)
- Alex: KMS runbook snippet in ticket (owner)
- Priya: customer comms + UX copy (owner)
- Sam: finalize dashboards and alerts (owner)
- Maya: finalize release notes and schedule launch gate meeting tomorrow 10am PT

Chad (Eng): :white_check_mark: will have PR up today.

Alex (Security): will add runbook by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Design): will drop copy options by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Observability): dashboard + alerts by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Maya (PM): thanks all. leaving this thread open until meeting. if anyone has a veto on the rollout triggers post now. otherwise i'll count this as alignment. :v:
